Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.FarPoints_toolt: Destinations around each player where wanderer groups start and roam.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.NearPoints_tool: Destinations close to each player. More of them make wanderers pass by more often.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.FarMinDistance_: In tiles. Bandits only starts groups more than 150 tiles away from every player.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.FarMaxDistance_: In tiles. Groups move about 4 tiles per game minute.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.NearMaxDistance: In tiles. Groups turn into NPCs 60 to 70 tiles away from a player.
Sandbox_BanditsLargeMaps.RecycleDistance: In tiles. Wanderer groups farther than this from every player are moved to a far point around a player.
